sources.imageCredit: Official Valentino Interferenze Fall/Winter 2026–27 campaign image. Photograph: Glen Luchford.
sources.usageStatus: Official brand image embedded and browser-verified; verify distribution permission before live send.
sources.selectedBecause: Valentino places its Interferenze Fall/Winter 2026–27 campaign inside Rome’s Centrale Montemartini, where antique sculpture and industrial machinery share the same rooms. Photographed and filmed by Glen Luchford, the images make the setting more than a backdrop. Tailoring, ornament and gesture move between old stone and dark metal, allowing different scales of history to meet within a single frame.

sources.imageCredit: Official LOEWE Fall Winter 2026 campaign image. Photograph: Talia Chetrit.
sources.usageStatus: Official brand image embedded and browser-verified; verify distribution permission before live send.
sources.selectedBecause: Talia Chetrit photographs LOEWE’s Fall Winter 2026 collection against the Mont Blanc Massif. Julia Garner and a wider cast move through snow and rock, where bold colour and sculptural volume meet a vast, pale landscape. The scale is theatrical, yet the images keep a sense of physical movement: clothes are seen against weather, altitude and the changing texture of the ground.

sources.imageCredit: Official Dior Winter 2026-2027 campaign image. Photograph: David Sims.
sources.usageStatus: Official brand image embedded and browser-verified; verify distribution permission before live send.
sources.selectedBecause: David Sims photographs Dior’s winter collection in a dreamlike French countryside, placing a violin, delphiniums, polka dots and check within spare, carefully composed frames. Clothing and landscape hold equal weight; the props interrupt any easy pastoral reading. There is a poised stillness to the series, but the slightly unexpected pairings keep the image alive with visual tension.
